digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot startup composition and per-operation auth/config isolation
propositions: MCP and review-bot must capture static deployment/startup config once at service initialization and compose a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot for each operation/request, ensuring that changing env/file material does not rebind a running process.

Inbound MCP bearer tokens must remain request-scoped context (via PROXY_IDENTITY ContextVar) and never enter startup/operation snapshots, logs, caches, or schemas; OperationSnapshot.build must reject SecretStr-typed values.

Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (gerrit_bot_token, GitHub, LLM credentials) before accepting a job/webhook, fail-closed on missing/blank/conflicting/revoked auth with no principal fallback, and forward the composed LLMRuntime through the code review decision flow.
Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup must fail-open and remain a no-op; missing/partial/rejected telemetry credentials disable telemetry only, leaving the underlying operation result unchanged.
Static binding replacement is observable only after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned refreshable capability behavior remains unaltered and independent of startup composition.

Per-operation non-secret config (Gerrit/GitHub/LLM policy) must be freshly composed for each request while startup static bindings (frozen LLMRuntime, non-secret policy) remain stable across ambient material mutation.
